consumption: Public classic browser scripts inside a dedicated random localhost viewer origin. The viewer host serves only fixed public files, with allow-scripts/allow-same-origin sandbox and restricted CSP. Parent and child messages verify exact origin and source window before token-bound operations. No package installation or script execution performed during development.

adapted_source.changes: Retained render options and heading recognition, adapted native directory controls within the verified dedicated Office viewer origin.
Retained per-text-node ranges and CSS Custom Highlights with native selection fallback and bounded search scope.
Retained Unicode source-offset case folding, removed TypeScript annotations for the static script and bounded match count.

Retained normalized per-section regions, source section context and html2canvas capture. Direct bounded crop avoids full-page bitmap allocation. Source section identity/layout, original file/upload/pinned-image proof are checked before use.

jot_source_adaptations.changes: Ported the original linear overlapping occurrence matcher into the isolated static frame. text_view 2 keeps the fixed rendered DOM traversal separate from existing structured protocol 1.

Original heading recognition/order and targets now index every heading in the admitted rendered document. Directory DOM is paginated to100 items, with previous/next/direct page navigation and existing256-unit short labels. Error/pagehide clear retained heading nodes and controls. Word region capture freezes directory controls with toolbar controls.

Boot/probe includes a unique static-document instance. Parent binds it before byte transfer and rejects a replacement document after initialization. Token-scoped pagehide notification invalidates old ready/reference sessions through the existing close/manual reread path. Same-document duplicate probes remain valid. No automatic file transfer or upload retry.

Retains original per-text-node exclusion/ranges, case-fold source mapping and highlights. Replaces total/node search truncation with cooperative16Ki source windows, surrogate-safe overlap and1000-result batches. Previous/next batches rescan saved source cursors, releasing old ranges. Query changes/pagehide cancel stale generations. Search and region capture exclude one another. Covers admitted rendered text; source/render limits remain.
